passages.note: House final passage of 2SB 100 with Yea from Peterson, V.; 6 of 75 members voted No (under 10%), so it cannot carry a chair alone.

passages.provision_quote: without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record
passages.note: Operative section bars shielding education records from parents and requires parental consent to change the record's gender identity; its object is the education record, not staff use of names or pronouns or a notice duty, so it shows the parent-side direction without matching any one rung's clauses.

rows.reasoning: Peterson voted Yea on SB 100 (2023), which forbids policies that shield a student's education record from parents and bars changing the record's gender identity "without written parental consent". That puts him on the parental-information side, but the bill acts on education records, not on "staff use a different name or pronouns" (rung 5), an affirmative duty to "notify parents" (rung 4), or telling parents "when parents ask" (rung 3), and the vote was near-unanimous.
